quote.text: Epicurus said: If you shape your life according to nature, you will never be poor, if according to people's opinions, you will never be rich
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Guide your children to value inner character and natural growth over the fleeting approval of others, fostering authenticity in their hearts.
    • Demonstrate that true wealth in life is measured by the love, wisdom, and resilience cultivated within, rather than by external success or material gains.
  • Leadership:
    • Lead by aligning your actions with steadfast principles and the natural order, rather than bending to the ever-changing opinions of the crowd.
    • Recognize that genuine influence comes from an inner strength, where integrity and wisdom create a lasting impact beyond momentary popularity.
  • Product Management:
    • Focus on developing products rooted in true human needs and natural desires, rather than chasing temporary trends or superficial accolades.
    • By maintaining a clear, value-driven vision, you create offerings that endure, reflecting an authentic commitment to quality and purpose over mere opinion-based success.
